Dying to be a body builder

By: Tarryn Crossman | Production

Proposal


Show:

Unique Selling Point:
Dying to be a body builder
Anabolic steroids are banned in competitive body building but speak to any body builder and they will tell that if you aren’t using, you can’t compete. We get access into the body building underworld and speak to young men and women risking their lives to place at body building stages around the world


Further information:
Liam is 26, he has already lost two friends in body building, the one died of a heart attack and the other one kidney failure
He is taking steroids used on cows to build muscle fast and intern burn fat. It is completely illegal, and he gets his supply from his coach/personal trainer. To “stay alive” he sees a doctor once a month to get a full medical checkup and have all his blood work done.
Liam says that 60-70% of the guys on stage, at body building comps, are using the same stuff. The major side effect for him is that he gets Hyperaggressive, to the point where when he is using a lot to get ready for a comp he has to isolate for other people’s safety.
Liam says he hates the drugs, but he is determined to turn pro, so he has no choice.
He has dedicated his life to this, and he will do whatever it takes to make it.

He is registered with the IFBB, according to them the use of steroids is illegal. They send out emails saying that these guys can be tested randomly, but according to Liam he has never been tested and no-one he knows has been tested
Liam’s coach is willing to speak to us anonymously about where he gets the drugs from and why he pushes Liam to use them. He supply’s the drugs and monitors how much Liam uses

Claudette- Using weed to get to the world champs
She has used steroids in the past but hated the side effects. She stopped her period, grew hair everywhere and her voice is now permanently damaged. “I used to be a singer and now I can’t reach a note”.
Her supplier was her trainer, boyfriend and a doctor, so her steroid consumption cycles were closely monitored. She also wanted to have a baby at some point, so she stopped completely 1 year ago
She is now trying to get to the world champs, in England, in November using weed and Sarms (Which are also not approved by the FDA and have been known to cause heart attacks and strokes)
She also takes Oestrogen blockers. The weed is an experiment to see if certain strains of Marijuana help with muscle building and fat burning.
She is willing to talk about everything on camera and give us all access to her life

Coaches of both competitors will tell us more about the industry and use of performance enhancing drugs
Claudettes coach is also her sponsor. He produces on of these USN type products called monster
